expected_issues.title: Generator returned by field_transformer is consumed twice
expected_issues.description:
The result of field_transformer is now iterated by the order check and then reused, so a transformer implemented as a generator is exhausted and the class ends up with missing attributes.

field_transformer may return any iterable (generators worked before). Moving the call before the mandatory/default order check means the check consumes the generator, and the later alias resolution and class building see an empty sequence. Materialise the result (tuple(...)) before iterating it more than once.
